evidence.headline: That starts with having third-party evaluations to independently review the safety of new and powerful AI systems.
evidence.idea: 🧵(1/7) Artificial Intelligence is threatening to upend every part of American life. And the U.S. Senate is acting too slowly. That’s why the race for Senate Majority Leader is so important.
bullets: We need stronger protections for high-risk AI and better systems to track incidents and vulnerabilities in real time to mitigate cyber and biorisks.
The penalties for knowingly deploying dangerous products should be severe enough to prevent companies from taking the risk.
We should consider a Select Committee on AI that has the power and resources to help the Senate keep pace with this rapidly evolving technology.
evidence.summary: We should be examining how best to promote competition and open-source innovation and considering a ban on Recursive Self-Improvement to prevent AI systems from autonomously advancing beyond our ability to control them.
evidence.practice_takeaway: That starts with having third-party evaluations to independently review the safety of new and powerful AI systems.
